title: Victory of the Antelope
simplified_paragraphs: 两只羚羊正在草原上吃草，就在这时，一只猎豹突然向小羚羊跑了过来。大羚羊连忙喊："快跑！”小羚羊听到了父亲的话，迅速跑走了。大羚羊一路指挥着小羚羊，虽然猎豹的速度很快，但它一直没能追上羚羊。
跑到安全的地方后，它们停了下来，小羚羊问父亲："为什么我们要跑呢？我们可以和猎豹对抗呀！”大羚羊笑了笑，说："如果我们和它对抗，那只能更早地成为它的晚饭。面对猎豹，我们只有先认输再逃跑才能获得最后的胜利。我们的胜利不是打倒它们，而是跑得比它们快！”
面对强敌时，只有"敢于认输”并"努力逃跑”，才有机会争取到真正属于自己的胜利。
traditional_paragraphs: 兩隻羚羊正在草原上吃草，就在這時，一隻獵豹突然向小羚羊跑了過來。大羚羊連忙喊："快跑！”小羚羊聽到了父親的話，迅速跑走了。大羚羊一路指揮著小羚羊，雖然獵豹的速度很快，但它一直沒能追上羚羊。
跑到安全的地方後，它們停了下來，小羚羊問父親："為什麼我們要跑呢？我們可以和獵豹對抗呀！”大羚羊笑了笑，說："如果我們和它對抗，那只能更早地成為它的晚飯。面對獵豹，我們只有先認輸再逃跑才能獲得最後的勝利。我們的勝利不是打倒它們，而是跑得比它們快！”
面對強敵時，只有"敢於認輸”並"努力逃跑”，才有機會爭取到真正屬於自己的勝利。
pinyin_paragraphs: liǎng zhī líng yáng zhèng zài cǎo yuán shàng chī cǎo， jiù zài zhè shí， yī zhī liè bào tū rán xiàng xiǎo líng yáng pǎo le guò lái。 dà líng yáng lián máng hǎn：" kuài pǎo！” xiǎo líng yáng tīng dào le fù qīn de huà， xùn sù pǎo zǒu le。 dà líng yáng yī lù zhǐ huī zhe xiǎo líng yáng， suī rán liè bào de sù dù hěn kuài， dàn tā yī zhí méi néng zhuī shàng líng yáng。

pǎo dào ān quán de dì fang hòu， tā men tíng le xià lái， xiǎo líng yáng wèn fù qīn：" wèi shén me wǒ men yào pǎo ne？ wǒ men kě yǐ hé liè bào duì kàng ya！” dà líng yáng xiào le xiào， shuō：" rú guǒ wǒ men hé tā duì kàng， nà zhǐ néng gèng zǎo de chéng wéi tā de wǎn fàn。 miàn duì liè bào， wǒ men zhǐ yǒu xiān rèn shū zài táo pǎo cái néng huò dé zuì hòu de shèng lì。 wǒ men de shèng lì bù shì dǎ dǎo tā men， ér shì pǎo de bǐ tā men kuài！”
miàn duì qiáng dí shí， zhǐ yǒu " gǎn yú rèn shū” bìng " nǔ lì táo pǎo”， cái yǒu jī huì zhēng qǔ dào zhēn zhèng shǔ yú zì jǐ de shèng lì。
english_paragraphs: Two antelopes were grazing on the grassland when a cheetah suddenly charged toward the young one. “Run!” the older antelope shouted. Hearing his father’s warning, the young antelope raced away. His father guided him as they ran, and although the cheetah was fast, it never caught up with them.

When they reached a safe place, they stopped. The young antelope asked his father, “Why did we run? We could have fought the cheetah!” The older antelope smiled. “If we had fought it, we would only have become its dinner sooner. When we face a cheetah, we have to admit defeat and run if we want to win in the end. Winning doesn’t mean knocking it down. It means running faster than it can!”
When facing a powerful enemy, only by being willing to admit defeat and doing your best to escape can you have a chance at a victory of your own.
english_full:
Two antelopes were grazing on the grassland when a cheetah suddenly charged toward the young one. “Run!” the older antelope shouted. Hearing his father’s warning, the young antelope raced away. His father guided him as they ran, and although the cheetah was fast, it never caught up with them.

When they reached a safe place, they stopped. The young antelope asked his father, “Why did we run? We could have fought the cheetah!” The older antelope smiled. “If we had fought it, we would only have become its dinner sooner. When we face a cheetah, we have to admit defeat and run if we want to win in the end. Winning doesn’t mean knocking it down. It means running faster than it can!”

When facing a powerful enemy, only by being willing to admit defeat and doing your best to escape can you have a chance at a victory of your own.
